A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
